title: CI runs the Stop check pytest and go receiver tests instead of skipping them
body:
Why: test/claude/worker-stop.test.ts runs the Stop check against real pytest and go test, but both skip when the runner lacks pytest/uvx and go (verified locally 2026-11-13 with uvx pytest and go 1.27.3; CI never ran them).
Outcome: CI installs pytest and go in the shard that runs test/claude, so the foreign-stack Stop check tests run on every PR and a skip there fails.
Proof: a CI log line showing both tests ok, not skipped.
Scope: .github/workflows/, test/claude/.
